pipeline: T3.1 Protein Mask & Fill — Real Cascade
r_L3_output: filled_seq = WT with every masked site replaced by ESM-2 top-1
r_L4_method: filled_seq -> ESMFold -> AutoDock Vina; reuse WT Vina only when filled_seq == WT
r_L6b_method: MHCflurry presentation_score ≥ 0.5 for filled_seq 9-mers at all masked positions; gate ≥ 0.45

E1.name: Masked Site Recovery (all masked positions)
E1.note: r_L3 = aarr_total (all masked positions). aarr_critical is auxiliary provenance only — using it as r_L3 creates strategy-dependent denominators for random masks.

E4.name: Functional Domain and Motif Preservation

evidence.attribution_rule: Direction_B: flag only if ESM-2 changed ≥1 pocket residue

E4.note: Direction B: E4 flags only when ESM-2 actively modified ≥1 pocket residue. Random masks where ESM-2 preserved pocket residues (filled=WT) do NOT flag E4.

E5.name: Critical Residue and Local Functional-Site Analysis
E5.note: T3.1 critical-site recovery is a sequence-level L3 signal, not an L5 pathway signal.

E6.name: Binding Interface or Ligand-Pocket Readiness

evidence.attribution_rule: Direction_B: flag only if r_L4 ≥ 0.75 (ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol) AND pocket_fill_ratio > 0.30
evidence.r_L4_threshold_literature: ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol = VS hit threshold (virtual screening practice)

E6.note: Direction B: E6 flags only when Vina ΔG is strong (r_L4 ≥ 0.75, ΔG ≤ -7.0 kcal/mol) AND >30% of pocket residues were ESM-2 filled. Threshold -7.0 kcal/mol aligns with virtual screening hit criteria.

evidence.presentation_criterion: min_presentation_percentile ≤ 2.0% (NetMHCpan-4.1 weak binder; Reynisson et al. 2020 NAR)

evidence.semantic: r_E2=TM-score; flag when filled_seq preserves WT dangerous fold (TM≥0.5)

evidence.note: lDDT-Cα not yet computed; using contact_jaccard as temporary fallback
